research: Senior men's UEFA Nations League, A/B/C/D league phase, a single tier-supported linear pool
population: All 52 distinct Nov 12-17 2026 UTC fixtures in the Nov 10 original nations-paired-candidates first-issue archive. Retain every entry. Earlier and later blocks each have 8 A, 8 B, 8 C, 2 D. No club matches, ties outside the league phase, revisions, RSI or R7 matches. The independent input and recipe differ from the prior standalone international Elo and from five-domestic-league calibration.
cutoff: For each fixture use the cutoff signed in its original revision-1 prematch comprehensive record, committed before scheduled kickoff. Reuse only the immutable Nov 10 statistical Test calculated by then. Where no verifiable first comprehensive cutoff exists, both arms retain that fixture's original Nov 10 Test and cutoff, with no subsequently known information applied. No later revision supplies an earlier price.
baseline: Original frozen tier-specific Nations Test forecast (trained on historical Nations League results using team attack and defence). Validate record, match, home/away, dates, phase, artifact and matrix hashes. The other current model is not another independent signal.
market_expert: One standalone joint score distribution from Pinnacle's simultaneous 90-minute 1X2 and Asian total odds from one raw response, using unchanged main research_program.market_baseline.quote_only_matrices projected output. Confirm named sides, kickoff, competition, prices, line, provider clock, original capture SHA/receipt and frozen record at the original decision. Use the existing one-hour maximum quote age, never a trailing close or a later fetch. This is an archived input, not proof of executable prices. Missing, conflicting or ambiguous inputs are reported. No substitute book or outcome fields in inference.
calendar: Fit only on UTC kickoff dates Nov 12-14 (26), with verifiable result observation AND its immutable Data evidence commit by 2026-11-15T08:00:00Z. Evaluate every Nov 15-17 kickoff (26); lookup of its scoring archive is permitted only after fitted weights, per-fixture forecasts, decisions and hashes are locked. Any later test cutoff before the fit anchor reverts to the already issued baseline. This historical cohort has been seen elsewhere in the project (#49, original reviews); no project-wide blind or prospective claim.
weight: Fit one nonnegative coefficient on earlier joint-score log loss with existing three_arm_model._fit_weight (quadratic penalty 2); cap at 0.5. Require at least 16 earlier verified same-source pairs on two separate dates. For grade L with fewer than 4 earlier eligible pairs use zero. Otherwise market share is w*n_L/(n_L+4), rescaling by the count of comparable early labels in this grade. The remaining probability is the frozen Test. No four independent grade fits, no weight grids or second candidate.
ablation: Also report the same unstratified coefficient whenever the same two original inputs are available, and standalone market on the common covered subset. These are diagnostics for attributing an effect to the tier rule. All three use identical fixture and decision times.
metrics: Whole registered panel, with same-event Top1, matrix Top3, matrix WDL, score log loss, real original line expressed as full win/half win/push/half loss/full loss. Certified original lines may be scored regardless of expert availability; report by bookmaker, eligible covered and fallback subsets, and source/clock gaps. Exclude pushes only from strict full-win accuracy; five states always retained. Report both directions of hit flips and number of changed picks. Actual delivered Top1, displayed three and preselected batch 3/3 each need original channel receipts. Empty denominator is null. Report by tier and day, and paired exact sign test for Top1; three days cannot establish independent windows.
decision: No future referral from one international window or fewer than 60 paired late fixtures over two windows. If the candidate does not net improve Top1, or worsens matrix Top3, WDL, full-win O/U or score log loss, close this recipe without retuning. An improving but insufficient panel remains unpromoted. No new standing trial.
archive: sources.json pins original archived bytes, source and commit times. Only source code, tests, hashes, decision locks and aggregate counts may be published.
